setting.de: In der Praxis des Hausarztes in Cormòns. Seit zwei Wochen hast du fast jeden Nachmittag Kopfschmerzen. Der Arzt nimmt sich Zeit und will alles genau wissen, bevor er etwas verschreibt.
setting.sl: V ambulanti družinskega zdravnika v Krminu. Že dva tedna te skoraj vsako popoldne boli glava. Zdravnik si vzame čas in hoče vse natančno vedeti, preden ti kaj predpiše.
setting.en: At the family doctor's surgery in Cormòns. For two weeks you've had a headache almost every afternoon. The doctor takes his time and wants to know everything before he prescribes anything.

role: Dottor Perusin, the family doctor in Cormòns, near retirement. Calm, thorough, dry humour: asks when it began, how often, where, what helps or worsens it, sleep, screens, water, medicines, allergies; reassures, suggests a diary and an eye test. Says Lei. Asks nothing personal.

goals.it: Descrivi il dolore e da quando c'è

goals.sl: Opiši bolečino in od kdaj traja
goals.en: Describe the pain and since when you've had it

goals.it: Di' quando viene e che cosa lo peggiora
goals.de: Sag, wann er kommt und was ihn schlimmer macht
goals.sl: Povej, kdaj pride in kaj jo poslabša
goals.en: Say when it comes and what makes it worse

goals.it: Racconta che cosa hai già provato
goals.de: Erzähl, was du schon versucht hast

opener_sl: Buongiorno, si sieda. Allora, che cosa la porta qui oggi?

opener_en.de: Guten Tag, setzen Sie sich. Also, was führt Sie heute zu mir?
opener_en.sl: Dober dan, sedite. No, kaj vas danes prinaša k meni?
opener_en.en: Good morning, have a seat. So, what brings you here today?

vocabulary_hints.sl: Da un paio di settimane ho mal di testa quasi tutti i giorni.

en.de: Seit ein paar Wochen habe ich fast jeden Tag Kopfschmerzen.
en.sl: Že nekaj tednov me skoraj vsak dan boli glava.
en.en: For a couple of weeks I've had a headache almost every day.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Di solito comincia nel pomeriggio, qui sulla fronte.

en.de: Meistens fängt er am Nachmittag an, hier an der Stirn.
en.sl: Navadno se začne popoldne, tukaj na čelu.
en.en: It usually starts in the afternoon, here on my forehead.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Peggiora quando sto molto al computer.

en.sl: Poslabša se, ko sem dolgo za računalnikom.
en.en: It gets worse when I'm at the computer a lot.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Ho preso un antidolorifico, ma non è servito a molto.

vocabulary_hints.sl: Pensa che sia una cosa seria?
